weeks.title: Matter & Atomic Structure: Scientific inquiry and measurement
weeks.instructor_overview: Introduce and develop scientific inquiry and measurement within the context of Matter & Atomic Structure. Use explicit instruction, worked examples or models, guided practice, and independent application.
learning_objectives: Describe the scientific concepts associated with scientific inquiry and measurement.
Use evidence, models, or observations to explain scientific relationships.
Apply the concepts to a real or simulated scientific situation.
warm_up: Recall one idea related to scientific inquiry and measurement.
Answer a short retrieval question from the previous week.
Write one question you expect this week's lesson to answer.

Teacher modeling and guided examples for scientific inquiry and measurement
Collaborative practice involving scientific inquiry and measurement
Independent application and reflection
